Ava: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to Miguel and Sophie for jumping in on onboarding yesterday. They turned a 2-hour support marathon into a clean handoff :raised_hands:
Miguel: ahaha thanks! Sophie did most of the heavy lifting with the SSO weirdness, I just chased logs and coffee :coffee:
Sophie: honestly Raj's idp mapping fix was the real MVP. saved us from a cascading failure :relieved:
Raj: I’ll accept MVP status if it comes with donuts. will leave coupons in the kitchen later :doughnut:
Kai: +1 from eng-ml — Miguel's step-by-step doc in the wiki made the rollout way smoother. copied into my runbook :notebook_with_decorative_cover:
Ava: also big thanks to @infra-bot for the alerting tweak that stopped the pager noise. saved multiple weekend hearts :heartpulse:
infra-bot: Automated note: Alert threshold adjusted for service:auth by Kai at 14:37 UTC
Sara: shoutout to DevOps too — the rollback yesterday was quick and painless, appreciated :thumbsup:
DevOps: thx! small tweak to the deploy script (added a short health-check wait) — glad it helped
Ava: can we collect these for the weekly kudos post? planning to paste into #all-hands on Friday
Miguel: go for it, happy to see the onboarding notes reused — feel free to tag me if you want a quote
Sophie: also can someone kudos the onboarding checklist updates? I edited a couple items and it might've saved an hour or two for the new hire
Kai: done — added a :thumbsup: reaction on the checklist PR
Ava: amazing — thanks everyone. small wins make a big difference :)
